notes: Timetable image is 777127b067d799c70842891a338d4ee7_20260729165935A634.png (941x1220). Its columns are 时间 / 报告题目 / 讲者 / 主持 — there is no separate 单位 column, so each 讲者 cell prints 'name role' on the first line and the organisation, when given, on the second. affiliation_raw therefore carries the whole remainder of the cell after the name, with the line break rendered as a space (e.g. '院士 清华大学', '工程副总裁 面壁智能'). The 13:30 and 13:35 致辞 cells print only '梅宏 院士' / '王怀民 院士' — no organisation is published for them, so affiliation_raw is just the role.

The 主持 column is a set of merged cells this file's shape has no field for, so it is recorded here: 张洪宇（重庆大学）chairs 13:30-15:10; 文俊浩（重庆大学）chairs 15:30-17:30; 曹东刚 chairs the 17:30-17:35 总结展望 (no organisation printed for him). The 15:10-15:30 茶歇 row spans all four columns and so has no chair.

The 15:00-15:10 Robonix战略合作揭牌仪式（梅宏院士、生态伙伴）row merges the 报告题目 and 讲者 columns — no speaker cell exists for it, so speakers is empty rather than guessed; the participants named inside the title are left in the title as printed.

16:10-16:30 prints '从四足到人形机器人--底层技术与产品演进' with two ASCII hyphens, and 16:50-17:10 prints a full-width colon in '从视控一体到具身智能：…'. Both differ from the CMS text the dataset was built from (which has '，' and ':' respectively); the image is transcribed as printed.
